programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. They open up about the class divide, self-doubt in breaking into television, and the £350,000 contract clause that nearly prevented their show from happening.

programme.title: What's Going Down In Fearne's WhatsApp Groups?
programme.desc: Fearne shares what's been making her laugh, what's been frustrating her, and the small moments helping her stay grounded. From outrageous chats with lifelong friends to worrying about things outside her control, this is an honest catch-up on the highs, lows and everything in between.

programme.title: Candice Carty-Williams On Queenie Is Working On It
programme.desc: This month in the Happy Place Book Club, we've been reading Queenie Is Working On It, by Candice Carty-Williams, the follow up to 2019's Queenie. In this chat with Fearne, live from the Happy Place Festival, Candice explains why she felt it was so important to write about big topics like medical racism and fertility pressures, as well as why for her characters come first and the plot is just a side quest.

programme.title: Will Poulter on OCD and Intrusive Thoughts
programme.desc: Actor Will Poulter discusses his experiences with OCD, anxiety, and intrusive thoughts with Fearne Cotton. Will explains how OCD has manifested since childhood and talks through why finding reasons to be grateful for the lessons mental health conditions have taught can be helpful.

programme.title: Who Do You Become On Holiday?
programme.desc: Fearne explores what she and Team Happy Place love about holidays and which bits can be rubbish.

programme.title: Sophie Ellis-Bextor On How To Make Your Holiday Magical
programme.desc: Sophie Ellis-Bextor discusses making family holidays magical with Fearne Cotton. As someone who travels extensively for work, Sophie explains how she and her husband plan their travel itineraries, share the joy of collecting passport stamps, and recommend destinations including Paris, Puglia, Ibiza, and Japan.

programme.title: Tulisa On Choosing Contentment Over Anger
programme.desc: Tulisa discusses choosing contentment over anger following testing life experiences including high-profile court cases. She talks about reaching a point where she genuinely doesn't mind if she's liked or not, how being a young carer for her mum still affects her today, and shares the backstory behind Britney Spears' accent on Scream & Shout.

programme.title: Tom Read Wilson On Being Okay With People Not Liking You
programme.desc: Tom Read Wilson chats with Fearne Cotton live from the Happy Place Festival about owning his differences and celebrating his eclectic personality. Both share their histories of extreme people-pleasing and what they've learnt about self-advocacy and uncomfortable confrontation.

programme.title: Goth Bride
programme.desc: They say anything goes in Hollywood, but wedding planner David Tutera is shocked to find out that bride Christina wants a wedding based on black. And she means it – Christina shows David a black bridal gown, black bridesmaids' dresses and finally a tiny black flower girl dress for her darling seven-year old daughter! Even her fiancé Eric tells David the wedding should be black, dark and creepy to fit their all-goth fashion style! David finds himself surrounded by enough skeletons, skulls and spiders to decorate a Halloween party, but nothing in wedding white. And when he takes Christina to a bridal shop filled with white dresses, she nearly has an anxiety attack! David has to find out just what makes this adorable goth bride tick, and when he does, he delivers a high-fashion, romantic wedding that's perfect for Christina.

David comes to the rescue of this good-hearted fashionista and turns her wedding into a runway success.

programme.title: Tuscany Bride

She wants a romantic outdoor wedding, but her vision of what Tuscany looks like is more than a little skewed, and her bright orange bridesmaid's dresses are only adding to the disaster. Worst of all, the bride, the groom, and the father-of-the-bride just lost their jobs and the wedding plans are going up in smoke. David Tutera will need all his skill and savvy to create the perfect Tuscan wedding in southern California.

programme.title: Dragonfly Bride
programme.desc: Bride Regina lost a child and wants a dragonfly-themed wedding as a symbol of hope. David Tutera has his work cut out for him, having to convince the bride that she deserves every part of the gorgeous garden wedding he's creating. The wedding dress Regina bought on sale is already frayed, and the bridesmaid's dresses are all different shades of green -- David's least favorite color for fashion. What's more, Regina and her fiancé are planning a backyard wedding with no food for the guests! David has one surprise after another for this sweet-natured bride, culminating in an emotional fairy-tale wedding with larger-than-life entertainment.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.
